We once discussed veterinary medicine from the perspective of how humans came to the idea of helping other living creatures while spending their own time and resources on it. Strictly speaking, this mostly applies to pets, because in the industrial world veterinarians often work with farm animals. Today I want you to think about how incredibly complex this science really is. A veterinarian has to understand the anatomy and physiology of dozens of different species in order to help them. From a tiny aquarium fish to a massive python, any creature may need care, and it is honestly impressive how veterinarians manage to keep all of this knowledge in their minds while making decisions that can determine the fate of their patients. Veterinarians save tens of thousands of beloved pets and prevent epidemics among farm animals, which in many ways also means protecting human populations. Thank you, veterinarians. #Veterinarian #Medicine #Animals #edit #Pets

Ever wonder why a hedgehog would need a bag clip? 🦔  This little guy came in for a limp, and X-rays revealed a fractured tibia. Trying the viral fruit ice creams again, and thankfully these were WAY better than the first batch my parents and I tried… because let’s just say there were a couple flavors that ended up getting spit right back out. 😂 The pineapple was my favorite by far! It was more like a sour sherbet than ice cream and so good. The banana was delicious too (my dad would absolutely be obsessed with it 🍌), and then there was the soccer ball one… which tasted great, but after breaking a tooth on a pretzel a few days before my wedding, biting into that thing gave me immediate PTSD. 😅⚽️ Also, my parents are currently on a road trip, and while they absolutely deserve every second of it, two weeks is a LONG time when you work out of a tiny shop at their house, rely on them for help with the kids, and have a second child who is basically a redheaded tornado. 😂 And before anyone says it… yes, I am 31 years old. But I honestly don’t know if my mom and I have ever gone two full weeks without seeing each other at least once. We live a few minutes apart, I work at her house, she helps with the kids, and we’re constantly together. So this may be harder on me than it is on her. 🤣 So here’s hoping these ice creams are good enough to convince them to come home a little sooner… totally kidding, Mom and Dad. Enjoy your trip. You both deserve it. ❤️ And yes, Dad, I’ll miss you too before you call me out in the comments. 😂 I love you just as much. Mom and I are just together all day, every day, so she’s usually the first person to hear every random thought, story, problem, and bit of tea I have to share. 🤣 #ViralIc#ViralIceCreamc#FruitIceCreame#TasteTestv#FoodReviewMadeMeBuyIt @Cherie🌺  @Kenny Leone   My girl @thatbarnyardbarbie that had my slaving today on her “thin” hair 🤣🤣🤣

"기계는 재료를 뭉개버린다"는 철학 아래, 매일 새벽부터 나와 모든 재료를 일일이 손으로 버무리고 직접 빚으시더라구요. 재료 하나하나의 식감이 살아있는 꽉 찬 만두 속은 그렇게 사장님의 고집으로 완성됩니다.  워낙 정성껏 소량만 준비하기 때문에 금세 품절되기로 유명한데요. 방문 전 전화 주문이나 네이버 예약을 이용하시면 헛걸음 없이 바로 가져가실 수 있으니 꼭 참고하세요!   주문 즉시 튀겨주시는 치즈 군만두는 갓 튀겨낸 바삭한 식감 속에 고소하게 늘어나는 치즈와 만두 속의 조화가 그야말로 환상적입니다.. 정성과 맛, 어느 하나 빠지지 않는 망원동의 진정한 인생 만두를 만나보세요!   - Deep flavor hand-mixed every dawn: Finding 'Grandmother's Touch' in a Young Master 📍망원 연만두 'Yeon-Mandu' (77, Mangwon-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea)   🔗 https://maps.app.goo.gl/jDhS1Q11mVTn1mBA9   'Yeon-Mandu' is a renowned dumpling spot near Mangwon Market, famous for a deep, traditional flavor that leads many to assume an elderly grandmother must be running the shop. Surprisingly, the true master behind these dumplings is a young man who has dedicated his life to this craft.   The secret to such profound flavor lies in his sincere devotion. Following his philosophy that "machines crush the ingredients' texture," he starts his day in the early hours of the dawn, hand-mixing and folding every single dumpling. This stubborn commitment is what creates the perfect filling, where the texture of each ingredient remains intact and vibrant.   Because each dumpling is made with such meticulous care in limited quantities, they are famous for selling out quickly. We highly recommend placing a phone order or using Naver Reservation before your visit to ensure you don't miss out!  Don't miss the Cheese Fried Dumplings, fried to order for a perfectly crispy texture. The harmony of the savory, melting cheese and the rich dumpling filling is simply heavenly. #mascara                                    Un mascara est un produit de maquillage destiné à être appliqué sur les cils afin de les allonger, les épaissir, les recourber et intensifier le regard. Il se présente généralement sous forme liquide ou crémeuse, contenu dans un tube avec une brosse applicatrice. Le mascara permet de donner plus de volume et de définition aux cils en les colorant, le plus souvent en noir, mais aussi en brun ou en couleurs plus originales. Selon sa formule et la forme de la brosse, il peut offrir différents effets : naturel, volumineux, allongeant ou recourbant. Facile à utiliser, il est un élément essentiel du maquillage des yeux, mais reste temporaire et s’enlève avec un démaquillant adapté.                     #lashes #prt #fyp #foryoupagе
